senses.gloss: to twist, plait; [b. h. to form a raised figure, cmp. גָּדַל II].
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 64a:2">Sabb. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>עני קוֹלֵעַ שלש וכ׳</he> a poor man twists three threads and hangs the cord around his daughter’s neck. Y. ib. X, 12ᶜ bot. <he>הקולע שלש וכ׳</he> he that plaits three strings of hair on a person’s head.

Tosef. Maasr. I, 6 היה עתיד לִקְלוֹעַ בשום ולאגוד וכ׳ (ed. Zuck. ליקָּלֵעַ … וליאגד, Nif.) if the intention was about the garlic crop to plait, and about the onions to tie them in bunches, אינו חייב עד שיִקְלַע ויאגד he is not bound to give the tithes until he plaits or ties (or עד שיִקָּלֵעַ ויֵאָגֵד until the things are plaited or bunched); a. e.—Trnsf. [to weave a wreath,] to adorn, praise.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII</cite>, end; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 846:1">Yalk. Ps. 846</cite> <he>הוא קוֹלֵעַ על יריאיו … קוֹלְעִים לו וכ׳</he> he (God) praises those who fear him, and those who fear him praise him; you say (<cite ref="Psalms 92:16">Ps. XCII, 16</cite>) &c., and I say, (<cite ref="Zephaniah 3:13">Zeph. III, 13</cite>) &c.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>היא קִילְּעָה לו וכ׳</he> (not <he>קולעה</he>) she plaited her hair to please him (her paramour), therefore the priest loosens her hair; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 3:3">Tosef. Sot. III, 3</cite> ed. Zuck. note <he>קלעה</he>; a. e.

senses.gloss: קִילְּעֶה or קִלְּעֶה (cmp. נתעלפה, s. v. עָלַף II) to plait a person’s hair, dress, adorn (v. supra).

II, 22</cite>) <he>מלמד שקילעה הקב״ה לחוה וכ׳</he> this intimates that the Lord dressed Eve &c., v. <cite ref="B00952"><he>בִּנְיָיתָא</he></cite>. Y. Snh. II, 20ᵃ bot. (ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 20:3">II Sam. XX, 3</cite> <he>ויכלכל</he>, v. <cite ref="K00755"><he>כִּלְכֵּל</he></cite>) <he>מלמד שהיה דוד מְקַלַּעֲתָן וכ׳</he> this teaches that David had them dressed and adorned and made them come before him every day, and said to his evil inclination &c.
